failure.summary: The deployed Client replaced the complete production Client bundle with a feature-only build that did not inherit the existing protected overlay.
observed_regressions: The account menu no longer exposed the usage dashboard entry.
The upload menu no longer exposed image upload, Office file upload, and text-extraction upload as the established three-option contract.
The Agent workspace no longer preserved the established two-category and managed preset presentation contracts.
failure.root_cause: client/artifact.json verified only the new reasoning markers and core bundles. remote-apply.sh then replaced /app/client/dist wholesale without proving inheritance of the ten protected assets or the existing Agent UI contract.

rollback.restore_scope: Restore the exact pre-release Compose override and Client mount, then recreate only LibreChat-API.

authenticated_browser_checks: The account menu again shows the usage dashboard entry.
The upload menu again shows image upload, Office file upload, and text-extraction upload with their descriptions.
The Agent workspace again shows only the promoted and all categories.
The seven managed preset Agents again omit the contact row.

configuration_note: The separate production change that removed preset effort fields from five model configurations is not part of this Client rollback and remains in effect.
decision: Do not finalize or redeploy this artifact. Build a new cumulative Client candidate from the complete protected production baseline, add inherited-asset and browser regression gates, and request a separate deployment approval.
